# Website

> Documentation site generated by imprensa.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://ilha.build/guide/getting-started/introduction/index.md): An introduction to ilha, a tiny isomorphic island framework with fine-grained signal reactivity.
- [.state()](https://ilha.build/tutorial/counter/state/index.md): Tutorial — define reactive state properties that trigger UI updates with the .state() builder method.
- [Installation](https://ilha.build/guide/getting-started/installation/index.md): Install ilha and start building with official templates for Vite, Hono, Nitro, and Elysia.
- [.on()](https://ilha.build/tutorial/counter/on/index.md): Tutorial — attach event listeners to elements inside your component with the .on() builder method.
- [Core Concepts](https://ilha.build/guide/getting-started/core-concepts/index.md): Learn the core ideas behind ilha — islands, signals, JSX rendering, and the builder chain.
- [.derived()](https://ilha.build/tutorial/counter/derived/index.md): Tutorial — compute values from state automatically with the .derived() builder method.
- [bind:](https://ilha.build/tutorial/counter/bind/index.md): Tutorial — two-way bind form elements to state with the bind: template syntax.
- [.effect()](https://ilha.build/tutorial/counter/effect/index.md): Tutorial — run reactive side effects whenever state changes with the .effect() builder method.
- [.onMount()](https://ilha.build/tutorial/counter/onmount/index.md): Tutorial — run one-time setup logic after a component first renders with the .onMount() builder method.
- [.input()](https://ilha.build/guide/island/input/index.md): Declare typed external props with optional Standard Schema runtime validation and coercion.
- [.state()](https://ilha.build/guide/island/state/index.md): Declare reactive signals local to an island to store values that change over time and drive re-renders.
- [.derived()](https://ilha.build/guide/island/derived/index.md): Declare computed values that depend on state or input, with built-in loading and error envelopes.
- [.on()](https://ilha.build/guide/island/on/index.md): Attach DOM event listeners to island hosts or descendant elements with selector syntax and modifiers.
- [.effect()](https://ilha.build/guide/island/effect/index.md): Register reactive side effects that run after mount and re-run when signal dependencies change.
- [.onMount()](https://ilha.build/guide/island/onmount/index.md): Register one-time setup functions that run after an island is mounted into the DOM.
- [.onError()](https://ilha.build/guide/island/onerror/index.md): Per-island .onError() handlers and app-wide onUncaughtError() for errors from .on(), .effect(), .onMount(), and transitions.
- [.transition()](https://ilha.build/guide/island/transition/index.md): Attach enter and leave animation callbacks to islands for async mount and unmount transitions.
- [.css()](https://ilha.build/guide/island/css/index.md): Attach scoped styles to an island using CSS @scope rules that stay local and do not leak.
- [.render()](https://ilha.build/guide/island/render/index.md): Finalize the builder chain and produce a callable island that can render JSX to HTML or mount in the browser.
- [.hydratable()](https://ilha.build/guide/island/hydratable/index.md): Render islands wrapped in hydration containers with serialized props and optional state snapshots.
- [Signals](https://ilha.build/guide/helpers/signals/index.md): Create free-standing reactive signals, share state across islands, batch writes, and peek at values without creating dependencies.
- [mount()](https://ilha.build/guide/helpers/mount/index.md): Auto-discover and mount ilha islands from the DOM, with support for lazy loading and hydration.
- [html&grave;&grave;](https://ilha.build/guide/helpers/html/index.md): An XSS-safe tagged template for building HTML strings with automatic escaping and signal interpolation.
- [raw()](https://ilha.build/guide/helpers/raw/index.md): Mark strings as trusted HTML to bypass escaping in JSX and html templates.
- [css&grave;&grave;](https://ilha.build/guide/helpers/css/index.md): A passthrough tagged template for CSS strings that enables editor tooling and syntax highlighting.
- [ilha](https://ilha.build/guide/libraries/ilha/index.md): Compact reference for the public exports from the ilha package.
- [@ilha/router](https://ilha.build/guide/libraries/router/index.md): A lightweight isomorphic router for ilha apps with file-system routing, loaders, and SPA navigation.
- [@ilha/store](https://ilha.build/guide/libraries/store/index.md): Shared reactive store for Ilha islands (alien-signals). Includes /form helpers for type-safe, schema-validated forms.
- [Showcase](https://ilha.build/guide/resources/showcase/index.md): A collection of websites and projects built with ilha.
